The tallest is Nate Reuvers at 211 cm. The youngest is Mario Saint-Supery (born 2006) and the most experienced Nikola Mirotic (born 1991). Beyond Spain, the squad draws most on USA (6), Argentina (1) and Cuba (1). Jasiel Rivero and Josep Puerto are back for another spell at the club.
